about.title: Containers shaped around what you actually need
about.intro: Euro Container Market started from a simple observation: the standard ISO shipping container, built for freight, is also one of the sturdiest, fastest-to-deploy, and cheapest-per-square-meter structures around — provided you know how to source it, inspect it, and sometimes rebuild it. That's the trade we've been in for over twenty years.
about.storyBody1: It began with reselling used shipping containers coming off the major Europe–Asia freight lines: units built to take years of port handling, retired by shipping lines long before the end of their useful life. We built our sourcing network around those flows, working directly with port depots in France, Belgium, and Germany.
about.storyBody2: Over time, demand shifted: our customers didn't just want storage anymore — they wanted to live, work, or host in a container. We built out a conversion workshop — insulation, wiring, openings, plumbing — to deliver turnkey office, bar, pool, and mobile-home containers, while holding every unit, new or used, to the same inspection standard before it goes live in the catalog.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Ordering, payment, delivery, withdrawal: everything you need to buy your container with confidence.
faq.contactText: Our team replies quickly, by phone or email.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Add the container to your cart, enter your details and delivery method, then choose to pay by card or bank transfer. You immediately receive an email with your order number (EC-XXXXXXXX) and a link to track it.

items.question: Are your prices excluding or including VAT?
items.answer: Prices are shown excluding VAT, with the price including VAT right below. VAT ({vat}%) is calculated at checkout on the order total, delivery included, and itemised in your summary and emails.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay) through our secure payment provider Stripe, and bank transfer. Card payment confirms your order immediately.

items.question: Is card payment secure?
items.answer: Yes. You enter your card on Stripe's payment page, certified PCI-DSS level 1: your card details never pass through our site and we never see them. Your bank may ask for 3D Secure authentication.

items.question: My card payment failed. What now?
items.answer: Nothing was charged and your order stays reserved. Open it from the email you received or from “My orders”: you can retry the payment in one click, or switch to bank transfer.

items.question: How do I pay by bank transfer?
items.answer: As soon as you order, your order page and confirmation email show the full bank details (beneficiary, IBAN, BIC, bank) and the exact amount. Each detail copies in one click, and a QR code lets you prefill the transfer from your banking app.

items.question: Which reference should I use?
items.answer: Your order number, formatted EC-XXXXXXXX. It lets us match your payment right away.

items.question: How long is my order reserved?
items.answer: {days} days from the order date. We send you a reminder before the deadline. Without payment in that time, the order may be cancelled and the container put back on sale: you will be notified by email.

items.question: How do I send proof of transfer?
items.answer: Once the transfer is made, open your order page and upload the screenshot or PDF from your bank (PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP, 5 MB max). This proof is required: it is how we know you have paid.

items.question: When is my order confirmed?
items.answer: As soon as the funds reach our account: usually 1 to 2 business days for a SEPA transfer, a few seconds for an instant transfer. You then receive a confirmation email and preparation starts.

items.question: I'm paying from outside the eurozone.
items.answer: Use an international (SWIFT) transfer: the BIC and the bank and beneficiary addresses are listed under “International transfer” on your order. Any sending fees charged by your bank are yours: the amount received must match the order total.

items.question: Where do you deliver, and how fast?
items.answer: We deliver across France and several European countries. Delivery areas, prices and estimated lead times are shown at checkout, before any payment. Lead time starts once payment is confirmed.

items.question: How does delivery work?
items.answer: The container is delivered by truck with suitable unloading equipment (flatbed, crane or loader arm depending on the case). We call you before dispatch to agree on a slot and check site access.

items.question: What do I need on site?
items.answer: Access suitable for a heavy goods vehicle, level and stable ground, and enough clear space to manoeuvre and set the container down. We give you the exact dimensions when we call. Mention any constraint (gate, slope, power lines) in the order note.

items.question: Can I collect the container myself?
items.answer: Yes, from our depot, by appointment. Bring a vehicle suitable for carrying a container; loading is handled on site.

items.question: New vs used: what's the difference?
items.answer: A new (or “one trip”) container has seen little or no sea freight. A used container has already been in service: it is inspected before sale and its condition is described on the product page.

items.question: Can I see the container before buying?
items.answer: Contact us: we can send extra photos or arrange a visit to the depot.

items.question: Do you offer converted containers?
items.answer: Yes: offices, fitted storage, bars, homes, pools… We also quote for custom work (windows, insulation, electrics).

items.question: Do you rent containers?
items.answer: Contact our team to discuss a rental option suited to your project and its duration.

items.question: Can I cancel my order?
items.answer: As long as no payment has been received, yes: on your order page, click “Cancel my order”; it is free and immediate. After payment, request a refund from the same page.

items.question: Do I have a right of withdrawal?
items.answer: Consumers have 14 days from receiving the container to withdraw, without giving a reason. Return costs are yours: we send you a collection quote. The right does not apply to containers converted or made to your specifications. Business purchases carry no right of withdrawal.

items.question: How am I refunded?
items.answer: Card payments are refunded to the card used. Bank transfers are refunded to the account whose IBAN you give in the request form (it is stored encrypted). Refunds are issued within 14 days of approval; your bank may take 1 to 5 business days to show them.

items.question: The container arrived damaged.
items.answer: Write precise reservations on the delivery note in front of the driver, take photos and contact us within 48 hours. You are also covered by the legal guarantees of conformity and against hidden defects.

items.question: Do I need an account to order?
items.answer: No, you can check out as a guest. An account lets you find all your orders, complete a payment in one click and skip retyping your details.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: Through the link in each of our emails, from your account, or on the “My orders” page with your order number and email.

items.question: I didn't receive the confirmation email.
items.answer: Check your spam folder. You can also find your order from “My orders” with your number and email, or contact us.

items.question: Can I order in my company's name?
items.answer: Yes: at checkout, click “I'm buying for a company” and enter its name and, if applicable, its EU VAT number. They will appear on your invoice.

items.question: Will I get an invoice?
items.answer: Yes, an invoice is sent to you once payment is confirmed.

items.question: My company is based in another EU country.
items.answer: If you have a valid EU VAT number, contact us before ordering: the sale can be invoiced without VAT under the reverse-charge mechanism.

items.question: Do you offer volume pricing?
items.answer: Yes, contact us for a tailored quote when ordering several units or for recurring projects.

sections.title: 1. Scope
paragraphs: These terms govern the sale of containers and related services on {siteName} between {company} (the “Seller”) and any buyer, whether a consumer (“Consumer”) or a business (“Business Customer”).
Placing an order implies acceptance of the terms in force on the order date. Consumer-specific provisions (withdrawal, legal guarantees, mediation) do not apply to Business Customers.

sections.title: 2. Products
paragraphs: The key features of each container (dimensions, new or used condition, equipment) are described on its product page. Photos of used containers are as accurate as possible; minor cosmetic differences (marks, scratches, patina) are inherent to used equipment.

sections.title: 3. Prices
paragraphs: Prices are in euros excluding VAT; the price including VAT is shown alongside. VAT at the applicable rate ({vat}%) is applied to the order total, delivery included.
Delivery charges depend on the selected area and are shown before the order is confirmed. The applicable price is the one displayed when ordering.

sections.title: 4. Ordering
paragraphs: The buyer selects products, enters their details and delivery method, chooses a payment method, then confirms by clicking “Pay” or “Order and pay by bank transfer”, which constitutes an order with an obligation to pay.

A confirmation email summarising the order is sent to the buyer. The Seller may cancel an order in case of a previous payment dispute, an obvious pricing error or unavailability; the buyer is then refunded in full.

sections.title: 5. Payment
paragraphs: Payment is made by card through the secure provider Stripe, or by bank transfer.
For bank transfers, the order is reserved for {days} days. If funds are not received in that time, the Seller may cancel the order and put the product back on sale; the buyer is informed by email.
The order is confirmed upon receipt of full payment.

sections.title: 6. Retention of title
paragraphs: The Seller retains ownership of the products until the price has been paid in full.

sections.title: 7. Delivery
paragraphs: Delivery lead times are estimates and run from payment confirmation. The Seller contacts the buyer to agree on a slot.

The buyer ensures access suitable for a heavy goods vehicle and a level, stable and clear drop-off area. If delivery is prevented by access conditions differing from those declared, additional travel costs may be charged.
Risk passes to the buyer when the container is handed over to them or to the person they designate.

sections.title: 8. Receipt and reservations
paragraphs: The buyer checks the container on delivery. Any damage or missing item must be precisely noted on the delivery note and reported to the Seller, with photos, within 48 hours.

sections.title: 9. Right of withdrawal (Consumers)
paragraphs: Under Article L221-18 of the French Consumer Code, Consumers have 14 days from receipt of the product to withdraw, without giving reasons.
They notify their decision by an unambiguous statement, for example from their order page (“Request a refund”), by email to {email}, or using the form below.

Return costs are borne by the Consumer. The Seller refunds all sums paid, including initial delivery costs (up to the standard delivery rate), within 14 days of being informed of the withdrawal; the refund may be withheld until the product has been collected.
Under Article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, the right of withdrawal does not apply to containers made to the Consumer's specifications or clearly personalised.

Withdrawal form: “To {company}, {address}, {email}: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the sale of the following goods: order number, ordered on / received on, consumer name, consumer address, date and signature (if sent on paper).”

sections.title: 10. Legal guarantees (Consumers)
paragraphs: Consumers benefit from the legal guarantee of conformity (Articles L217-3 et seq. of the French Consumer Code) for 2 years from delivery, and the guarantee against hidden defects (Articles 1641 et seq. of the French Civil Code) for 2 years from their discovery.
For used goods, lack of conformity is presumed for 12 months.

sections.title: 11. Business Customers
paragraphs: For Business Customers, products are guaranteed against hidden defects under general law. The Seller's liability is limited to the amount of the order concerned, except in case of gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

sections.title: 12. Personal data
paragraphs: Data collected when ordering is processed in accordance with our privacy policy.

sections.title: 13. Mediation (Consumers)
paragraphs: In the event of a dispute, the Consumer first sends a written complaint to the Seller. Failing an amicable solution within two months, they may refer the matter free of charge to the consumer mediator: {mediatorName} ({mediatorUrl}). They may also use the EU online dispute resolution platform: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.

sections.title: 14. Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by French law. For Business Customers, any dispute falls under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the Seller's registered office.

sections.title: Before payment: instant cancellation
paragraphs: As long as no payment has been received, you can cancel your order for free from its page, in one click. The container goes straight back on sale.

sections.title: 14-day right of withdrawal (consumers)
paragraphs: As a consumer, you have 14 days from receiving the container to withdraw, without giving a reason. Submit your request from your order page (“Request a refund”) or by email to {email}.
Return costs are yours: we send you a collection quote. This right does not apply to containers converted or made to your specifications, nor to business purchases.

sections.title: Damaged or non-conforming container
paragraphs: Write precise reservations on the delivery note, take photos and contact us within 48 hours. Depending on the situation, we offer repair, replacement or a refund, under the legal guarantees of conformity and against hidden defects.

sections.title: Refunds
paragraphs: Card payment: refunded to the card used. Bank transfer: refunded to the account whose IBAN you enter in the request form (stored encrypted).
Refunds are issued within 14 days of approval. You are kept informed by email at every step.

sections.title: Areas and prices
paragraphs: We deliver across France and several European countries. Available areas, their prices (excluding VAT) and estimated lead times are shown at checkout, before any payment. Collection from our depot, by appointment, is also available.

sections.title: How it works
paragraphs: Once payment is confirmed, we call you to agree on a slot and check site access. The container is delivered by truck with suitable unloading equipment.

sections.title: What you need on site
paragraphs: Access suitable for a heavy goods vehicle, level and stable ground, and enough clear space to manoeuvre. Mention any constraint (gate, slope, power lines) in the order note.

sections.title: On delivery
paragraphs: Check the container in front of the driver, note any reservations on the delivery note, and report them to us within 48 hours with photos.
